Class Tribe

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.model.player.Tribe
public class Tribe extends Object
Holds the entire mutable state of a single player.

A tribe groups the player's acquired characters (indexed by CharacterType), their buildings and collected artifacts, the current food and prestige points, and all the running modifiers granted by card effects (discounts, shaman stars and the various boolean bonuses such as shaman safety/doubling or extra food/pick rights). Card strategies read and update this state, and the tribe also knows how to compute the derived figures needed to resolve effects (completed sets, inventor pairs) and the final end-game score.

      public void addToTribe(BuildingCard card)
      Adds a building to the tribe and immediately accrues its prestige points.

      The building's prestige points are accumulated into buildingPoints at purchase time, so they are already accounted for when the end-game score is computed.

    • payFood

      public void payFood(int food, int ppPerFood)
      Pays an amount of food, falling back to prestige points when food runs short.

      If the tribe holds enough food, the amount is simply deducted. Otherwise the available food is consumed down to zero and the missing units are charged as a prestige point loss, at a rate of ppPerFood points per missing unit.

      Parameters:
      food - the amount of food to pay (must be positive)
      ppPerFood - the prestige points lost per unit of food that cannot be covered (must be positive)

    • minListSize

      public int minListSize()
      Returns the number of complete character sets owned by the tribe.

      A complete set contains one character of every CharacterType, so the count of full sets equals the size of the smallest per-type list. If the tribe is somehow missing an entry for a type, the method returns 0.

      Returns:
      the number of complete character sets (0 if at least one type is absent)

    • countInventorPairs

      public int countInventorPairs()
      Returns the number of inventor pairs the tribe owns.

      Two artifacts of the same kind form a pair, so the total is the sum, over every artifact, of its count divided by two (integer division).

      Returns:
      the number of matching artifact (inventor) pairs

    • computeTotalEndGameScore

      public void computeTotalEndGameScore()
      Finalizes the tribe's score at the end of the game by folding every deferred bonus into currentPrestigePoints.

      On top of the points already accumulated during play, this adds: the points granted by builders and by buildings; 10 points for every pair of artists; and, for inventors, the number of inventors multiplied by the number of distinct artifacts collected.

    • toSnapshot

      public TribeSnapshot toSnapshot()
      Captures the full state of the tribe into an immutable snapshot.

      Characters and buildings are stored by their card id (to be resolved later through a card map), while artifacts, resources, modifiers and flags are copied as-is.

      Returns:
      a TribeSnapshot describing the current state

    • fromSnapshot

      public static Tribe fromSnapshot(TribeSnapshot snapshot, Map<String,Card> cardMap)
      Rebuilds a tribe from a snapshot, resolving card ids through the given card map.

      Character and building ids are looked up in cardMap and re-filed into the new tribe, artifacts are converted back to their enum keys, and every resource, modifier and flag is restored from the snapshot.

      Parameters:
      snapshot - the snapshot describing the persisted tribe state
      cardMap - a lookup from card id to the corresponding Card instance
      Returns:
      the reconstructed Tribe
